payments.back.description: Link from the PAY.JP checkout or card page back to where the user came from (ADR-0099 §3).

payments.card.description: Label of PAY.JP's card form (number, expiry, security code) on the checkout and card pages.

payments.card_note.defaultMessage: カードの情報は PAY.JP のフォームに入力され、このサーバーには届きません。
payments.card_note.description: Note under the card form of the PAY.JP checkout and card pages.

payments.checkout.price_month.description: Price of a monthly plan on the PAY.JP checkout page. {amount} is in yen.

payments.checkout.price_year.description: Price of a yearly plan on the PAY.JP checkout page. {amount} is in yen.

payments.checkout.submit.description: Button of the PAY.JP checkout page that verifies the card (3-D Secure) and starts the subscription.

payments.checkout.title.description: Title of the PAY.JP checkout page. {plan} is the name of the plan.

payments.email.description: Label of the email field of the PAY.JP checkout and card pages, which the card's 3-D Secure needs.

payments.error.declined.defaultMessage: カードで支払えませんでした。別のカードを試してください。
payments.error.declined.description: Error of the PAY.JP checkout and card pages when the payment with the card failed.

payments.error.form.defaultMessage: メールアドレス・カードの名義・カードを確かめてください。
payments.error.form.description: Error of the PAY.JP checkout and card pages when a field is missing or invalid.

payments.error.state.defaultMessage: このページの有効期限が切れています。元の画面からやり直してください。
payments.error.state.description: Error of the PAY.JP checkout and card pages when their link is expired or altered.

payments.error.three_d_secure.defaultMessage: カードの本人認証 (3D セキュア) ができませんでした。もう一度試すか、別のカードを使ってください。
payments.error.three_d_secure.description: Error of the PAY.JP checkout and card pages when the 3-D Secure of the card failed.

payments.error.title.description: Title of the error page of the PAY.JP checkout and card pages.

payments.error.unavailable.defaultMessage: PAY.JP が応答しません。しばらくしてから試してください。
payments.error.unavailable.description: Error of the PAY.JP checkout and card pages when PAY.JP failed or did not answer.

payments.fake.cancel.description: Button of the fake provider's checkout page that goes back without subscribing.

payments.fake.fail.description: Button of the fake provider's checkout page that makes the payment fail, to test the failure.

payments.fake.failed.defaultMessage: 指示どおり支払いを失敗させました。支払うか取り消してください。
payments.fake.failed.description: Alert of the fake provider's checkout page after its fail button.

payments.fake.notice.defaultMessage: 試験用のビルドの決済です。事業者の画面の代わりで、お金は動きません。
payments.fake.notice.description: Notice of the checkout and portal pages of the fake payment provider, which only test builds have (ADR-0117 §2).

payments.fake.pay.description: Button of the fake provider's checkout page that records the subscription as paid.

payments.fake.portal.defaultMessage: 試験用のビルドには、管理する支払い方法や請求書がありません。
payments.fake.portal.description: Text of the fake provider's portal page.

payments.fake.price_month.description: Price of a monthly plan on the fake provider's checkout page. {amount} is the amount in major units, already formatted; {currency} is its ISO 4217 code.

payments.fake.price_year.description: Price of a yearly plan on the fake provider's checkout page. {amount} is the amount in major units, already formatted; {currency} is its ISO 4217 code.

payments.name.description: Label of the card holder's name field of the PAY.JP checkout and card pages.

payments.name_hint.defaultMessage: カードに記載のとおり、半角の英字で入力してください。
payments.name_hint.description: Hint under the card holder's name field of the PAY.JP checkout and card pages.

payments.portal.amount.description: Column heading of the payments table of the PAY.JP card page.

payments.portal.amount_value.description: An amount in the payments table of the PAY.JP card page. {amount} is in yen.

payments.portal.card.description: Heading of the card on the PAY.JP card page.

payments.portal.card_value.description: The card on the PAY.JP card page: its brand, last four digits, and expiry month and year.

payments.portal.change_card.description: Heading and button of the card change form on the PAY.JP card page.

payments.portal.changed.defaultMessage: カードを変更しました。
payments.portal.changed.description: Notice of the PAY.JP card page after a card change.

payments.portal.date.description: Column heading of the payments table of the PAY.JP card page.

payments.portal.history.description: Heading of the payments table of the PAY.JP card page.

payments.portal.history_empty.defaultMessage: 支払いはまだありません。
payments.portal.history_empty.description: Text of the PAY.JP card page without payments.

payments.portal.no_card.defaultMessage: カードは登録されていません。
payments.portal.no_card.description: Text of the PAY.JP card page without a card.

payments.portal.paused.defaultMessage: 直近の支払いに失敗したため、加入が止まっています。カードを変更すると支払って再開します。
payments.portal.paused.description: Alert of the PAY.JP card page while a subscription is paused after a failed payment.

payments.portal.refunded.description: Column heading of the payments table of the PAY.JP card page: the refunded amount.

payments.portal.resume_failed.defaultMessage: カードを変更しましたが、支払いに失敗しました。別のカードを試してください。
payments.portal.resume_failed.description: Alert of the PAY.JP card page when the payment that resumes a paused subscription failed.

payments.portal.resumed.defaultMessage: カードを変更し、加入を再開しました。
payments.portal.resumed.description: Notice of the PAY.JP card page after a card change resumed a paused subscription.

payments.portal.title.description: Title of the PAY.JP card page (the customer portal).

payments.test_mode.defaultMessage: テストのモードです (課金されません)。
payments.test_mode.description: Banner of the PAY.JP checkout and card pages with test keys.
